notes: אֶל before מִי is left unrepresented because the ASV's like realizes דָּמָה's own lexeme (rule 40); the competing reading giving like to the preposition is named in that unit's note.
Contrast EZK.31.18, where the ASV does write To for the same preposition and it aligns; each verse is decided on its own ASV wording.
מֶלֶךְ is rendered anarthrously, so no the is supplied for it (rule 29).
